title: build-kernel
responsibility: Builds the native and Wasm kernels with the pinned toolchain and records their sizes and hashes.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by run() when a spawned command does not exit with code 0: the pinned cargo or rustc from rust(), or wasm-opt --version from optimize(). The message is the command joined with spaces and then the word failed, and nothing in this file catches it.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown by pinnedToolchain(), which rust() calls before each cargo or rustc run, when the current directory is not an existing directory, no rust-toolchain.toml is found from it upward, the rust-toolchain.toml cannot be parsed or has no usable toolchain.channel, or rustup cannot select the pinned tool; nothing in this file catches it.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A Node.js file-system Error from readFile, copyFile, readdir, mkdir or writeFile when the call fails, for example on a missing file or directory; the error carries a code such as ENOENT, and this file does not catch it. pinnedToolchain() also rethrows a read of rust-toolchain.toml that fails with a code other than ENOENT.
